# External command adapters

The compatibility matrix of spec v0.3 §1.66, derived from `docs/spec/adapters/first-party/*.yaml`. A tool not listed here runs raw, exactly as typed; a listed tool runs raw too whenever the typed invocation is not one its adapter declares, or the installed version is outside the declared range — `explain <command>` says which. `raw <command>` bypasses the layer unconditionally (spec v0.3 §1.2).

| tool | adapter | versions | tier | invocations | schema | demand | fallback |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `stat` | [`org.ono.compat.coreutils.stat`](org.ono.compat.coreutils.md#stat) | `>=8.0` | B | `stat [-L\|--dereference] <path …>` | `ono.file/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `df` | [`org.ono.compat.coreutils.df`](org.ono.compat.coreutils.md#df) | `>=8.21` | B | `df [-a\|--all] [-l\|--local] [-t\|--type <fs>] [-x\|--exclude-type <fs>] [path …]` | `ono.filesystem/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `curl` | [`org.ono.compat.curl.curl`](org.ono.compat.curl.md#curl) | `>=7.75` | B | `adapt curl [-L] [-k] [-f] [-4\|-6] [--compressed] [-X <method>] [-d <data>] [-m <seconds>] <url …>` | `ono.http-exchange/1` | structured | error |
| `find` | [`org.ono.compat.findutils.find`](org.ono.compat.findutils.md#find) | `>=4.4` | B | `find [-H\|-L\|-P] [path …] [tests …] — every test, no action` | `ono.file/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `git` | [`org.ono.compat.git.git-status`](org.ono.compat.git.md#git-status) | `>=2.11` | B | `git status [-uall\|-uno\|-unormal] [--ignored] [pathspec …]` | `ono.git-status-entry/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `git` | [`org.ono.compat.git.git-log`](org.ono.compat.git.md#git-log) | `>=2.11` | B | `git log [-n <count>] [--since <time>] [--until <time>] [--author <pattern>] [--grep <pattern>] [--all] [--merges\|--no-merges] [--first-parent] [<revision …>] [-- <path …>]` | `ono.commit/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `ip` | [`org.ono.compat.iproute2.ip-address`](org.ono.compat.iproute2.md#ip-address) | `>=5.10` | A | `ip [-4\|-6] address\|addr\|a [show] [dev <name>] [scope <scope>] [up]` | `ono.interface-address/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `ip` | [`org.ono.compat.iproute2.ip-link`](org.ono.compat.iproute2.md#ip-link) | `>=5.10` | A | `ip [-4\|-6] link\|l [show] [dev <name>] [up]` | `ono.interface/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `ip` | [`org.ono.compat.iproute2.ip-route`](org.ono.compat.iproute2.md#ip-route) | `>=5.10` | A | `ip [-4] route\|r [show] [table <table>] [dev <name>] [proto <protocol>]` | `ono.route/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `ip` | [`org.ono.compat.iproute2.ip-route6`](org.ono.compat.iproute2.md#ip-route6) | `>=5.10` | A | `ip -6 route\|r [show] [table <table>] [dev <name>]` | `ono.route/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `ip` | [`org.ono.compat.iproute2.ip-neigh`](org.ono.compat.iproute2.md#ip-neigh) | `>=5.10` | A | `ip [-4\|-6] neigh\|neighbour\|neighbor\|n [show] [dev <name>]` | `ono.neighbor/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `ss` | [`org.ono.compat.iproute2.ss-tcp`](org.ono.compat.iproute2.md#ss-tcp) | `>=5.0 <7` | C | `ss -t[a\|l][n][p][e][4\|6] — TCP only, so the Netid column is absent and the protocol is the invocation's` | `ono.socket/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `ss` | [`org.ono.compat.iproute2.ss-udp`](org.ono.compat.iproute2.md#ss-udp) | `>=5.0 <7` | C | `ss -u[a\|l][n][p][e][4\|6] — UDP only` | `ono.socket/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `ss` | [`org.ono.compat.iproute2.ss`](org.ono.compat.iproute2.md#ss) | `>=5.0 <7` | C | `ss [-t -u][a\|l][n][p][e][4\|6] — with the Netid column` | `ono.socket/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `lsof` | [`org.ono.compat.lsof.lsof`](org.ono.compat.lsof.md#lsof) | `>=4.89` | B | `lsof [-n] [-P] [-i] [-U] [-p <pids>] [-u <users>] [-c <command>] [-d <fds>] [path …]` | `ono.open-file/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `ps` | [`org.ono.compat.procps.ps`](org.ono.compat.procps.md#ps) | `>=3.3` | B | `ps aux\|ax\|axu — every process`<br>`ps -e\|-A\|-ef\|-ejH — every process`<br>`ps -A — every process`<br>`ps [-u\|-U <user>] [-p\|--pid <pid,…>] [-C <name>] [-t <tty>] [-g\|-G <group>] — a selection` | `ono.process/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `journalctl` | [`org.ono.compat.systemd.journalctl`](org.ono.compat.systemd.md#journalctl) | `>=245` | A | `journalctl [-u\|--unit <unit>] [-p\|--priority <range>] [-n\|--lines <count>] [--since <time>] [--until <time>] [-b\|--boot [id]] [-k\|--dmesg] [-r\|--reverse] [-g\|--grep <pattern>] [-e]`<br>`journalctl -f\|--follow [-u <unit>] [-p <range>] [-n <count>] — a live stream until Ctrl-C` | `ono.journal-event/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `systemctl` | [`org.ono.compat.systemd.systemctl-list-units`](org.ono.compat.systemd.md#systemctl-list-units) | `>=246` | A | `systemctl list-units [-a\|--all] [-t\|--type <type>] [--state <state>] [--failed] [pattern …]` | `ono.service/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `systemctl` | [`org.ono.compat.systemd.systemctl-show`](org.ono.compat.systemd.md#systemctl-show) | `>=246` | B | `systemctl show <unit …>` | `ono.service/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `lsblk` | [`org.ono.compat.util-linux.lsblk`](org.ono.compat.util-linux.md#lsblk) | `>=2.37` | A | `lsblk [-a\|--all] [-d\|--nodeps] [device …]` | `ono.block-device/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `findmnt` | [`org.ono.compat.util-linux.findmnt`](org.ono.compat.util-linux.md#findmnt) | `>=2.37` | A | `findmnt [--real] [target\|source]` | `ono.mount/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
| `lsns` | [`org.ono.compat.util-linux.lsns`](org.ono.compat.util-linux.md#lsns) | `>=2.37` | A | `lsns [-t\|--type type]` | `ono.namespace/1` | structured, interactive | raw |
